texts.title: Bridging Traditions: Alchemy, Chemistry and Paracelsian Practices in the Early Modern World
texts.author_or_tradition: Edited by Karen Hunger Parshall, Michael T. Walton, Bruce T. Moran
texts.significance: Major edited volume examining connections between medieval alchemy, Paracelsian medicine, and early modern chemistry. Essays by leading historians (Newman, Principe, Kahn, Smith, Moran, others) establishing alchemy as continuous tradition bridging medieval and early modern natural philosophy. Essential resource for understanding historiographical frameworks of 'new alchemy studies.'
